p.src: 1  A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

en: A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
u.src: 1  A revelation about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.

p.src: 2  The LORD is a jealous God and avenges. The LORD avenges and is full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he maintains wrath against his enemies.

ja: 主 は、ねたむ神、復讐を遂げる方。
は復讐を遂げ、憤りを燃やされる。
en: The LORD is a jealous God and avenges. The LORD avenges and is full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he maintains wrath against his enemies.
u.src: 2  The LORD is a jealous God and avenges. The LORD avenges and is full of wrath. The LORD takes vengeance on his adversaries, and he maintains wrath against his enemies.

ja:
1:2 すべて大文字の「主」または「神」はヘブル語のיהוה（ヤハウェ）から来ている。ただし、短い形のיה（ヤハ）から来ていると記されている場合を除く。
1:2 ここで「神」と訳されているヘブル語はאֱלֹהִים（エロヒム）である。
en:
1:2 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה”, usually pronounced Yahweh).
1:2 The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים” (Elohim).

p.src: 3  The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. The LORD has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

en: The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. The LORD has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
u.src: 3  The LORD is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. The LORD has his way in the whirlwind and in the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.

p.src: 4  He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel languish. The flower of Lebanon languishes.

ja: ると、海は干上がり、 すべての
も枯れる。 バシャンとカルメルはしおれ、 レバノンの
en: He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel languish. The flower of Lebanon languishes.
u.src: 4  He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, and dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel languish. The flower of Lebanon languishes.

p.src: 5  The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it.

en: The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it.
u.src: 5  The mountains quake before him, and the hills melt away. The earth trembles at his presence, yes, the world, and all who dwell in it.

p.src: 6  Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him.

ja: に立てるだろうか。 だれがその燃える
えられるだろうか。 その憤りは
en: Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him.
u.src: 6  Who can stand before his indignation? Who can endure the fierceness of his anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and the rocks are broken apart by him.

p.src: 7  The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.

en: The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
u.src: 7  The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.

p.src: 8  But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.

ja: によって、 ニネベの地をことごとく
en: But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.
u.src: 8  But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.

p.src: 9  What do you plot against the LORD? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.

ja: はことごとく滅ぼし尽くす。
en: What do you plot against the LORD? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.
u.src: 9  What do you plot against the LORD? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.

p.src: 10  For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.

en: For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.
u.src: 10  For entangled like thorns, and drunken as with their drink, they are consumed utterly like dry stubble.

p.src: 11  One has gone out of you who devises evil against the LORD, who counsels wickedness.

ja: 主に逆らって悪を企み、 邪悪なはかりごとを勧める者が、 あなたの
en: One has gone out of you who devises evil against the LORD, who counsels wickedness.
u.src: 11  One has gone out of you who devises evil against the LORD, who counsels wickedness.

p.src: 12  The LORD says: “Though they are in full strength and likewise many, even so they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.

ja: され、消え去る。 私はあなたを
en: The LORD says: “Though they are in full strength and likewise many, even so they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.
u.src: 12  The LORD says: “Though they are in full strength and likewise many, even so they will be cut down and pass away. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.

p.src: 13  Now I will break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds apart.”

ja: のくびきをあなたから
き、 あなたを縛るものを
en: Now I will break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds apart.”
u.src: 13  Now I will break his yoke from off you, and will burst your bonds apart.”

p.src: 14  The LORD has commanded concerning you: “No more descendants will bear your name. Out of the house of your gods, I will cut off the engraved image and the molten image. I will make your grave, for you are vile.”

ja: を継ぐ子孫は、 もはや生まれない。 私はあなたの
を取り除く。 私はあなたの
える。 あなたは卑しむべき者だからだ。」
en: The LORD has commanded concerning you: “No more descendants will bear your name. Out of the house of your gods, I will cut off the engraved image and the molten image. I will make your grave, for you are vile.”
u.src: 14  The LORD has commanded concerning you: “No more descendants will bear your name. Out of the house of your gods, I will cut off the engraved image and the molten image. I will make your grave, for you are vile.”

p.src: 15  Behold, on the mountains the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace! Keep your feasts, Judah! Perform your vows, for the wicked one will no more pass through you. He is utterly cut off.

en: Behold, on the mountains the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace! Keep your feasts, Judah! Perform your vows, for the wicked one will no more pass through you. He is utterly cut off.
u.src: 15  Behold, on the mountains the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace! Keep your feasts, Judah! Perform your vows, for the wicked one will no more pass through you. He is utterly cut off.

ja: 1:15 「見よ」は、ヘブル語のהִנֵּהに由来し、「見なさい」「注意を向けなさい」という意味を持つ間投詞として用いられる。
en: 1:15 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.
